title: Speed From Counts: Differencing an Encoder at Every Speed It Turns

questions.question: An encoder of 1000 counts a revolution turns at 0.05 revolutions a second and its speed is taken as the difference of successive counts at 1 kHz. What does it read?
options: 1000 counts a second for one sample and zero for the other nineteen, an rms error of more than four times the speed
50 counts a second, a little noisy
questions.explanation: A sample can only hold a whole number of counts. At 50 counts a second that is one count every 20 samples.

questions.question: A window of 50 samples read 0.5 rev/s to within 2 percent. What did it cost?
options: Delay: it reports the average speed over the window, which is the speed half a window ago, 25 ms
questions.explanation: A speed that doubled at sample 200 reached the halfway value 24 samples later.

questions.question: The time between counts read 0.05 rev/s to 1.6 percent and 50 rev/s to 54.1 percent. Why?
options: The encoder is worse at high speed
A clock tick is a tiny part of a long gap and a large part of a short one: ten microseconds against twenty milliseconds, and against twenty microseconds
The sample rate is too low
questions.explanation: The resolution of edge timing is a clock tick, so it is best when the gaps are long.

questions.question: An encoder stops. What should the edge timing estimate do, and why?
options: Fall: a stopped encoder produces no edges, so the speed can only be lower than the last gap says, at most one count over the time since the last edge
questions.explanation: 500 counts a second read 10 a tenth of a second after the last edge and 1 after a second.

questions.question: Why is the first edge after a reversal not used for a speed?
options: It is the same position crossed the other way, so the time since the previous edge says nothing about how fast it is going back
questions.explanation: The estimate is zero until a second edge in the new direction, and then it is signed the other way.

questions.question: How does the combined estimate get within 2 percent at every speed?
options: It takes the edge timing when it exists and is below 1500 counts a second, and the window otherwise, each where it is good
questions.explanation: 1.6, 1.6, 0.3 and 0.0 percent, against 435.9 and 54.1 for the worst of the others.
